blocks.text: For Capacitor teams choosing between two independent live update services. Both offer live updates and native builds; the differences are pricing, open-source scope, and track record.
Pick Capawesome for the lowest entry price and git-driven builds. Pick Capgo for a backend you can read and self-host, free MPL-2.0 plugins, and production scale since 2021.
14-day unlimited free trial. No credit card required.
Capgo vs Capawesome Cloud at a glance
Capgo vs Capawesome Cloud, as of September 2026. Each Capawesome Cloud fact links to a numbered source listed below the table.
From $12/month billed yearly or $14 billed monthly. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. No free plan.
Live Updates plans from $9/month (1K MAU) to $249/month (250K MAU). Platform plans with native builds from $19/month to $499/month. 14-day free trial.
Ships JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and asset changes without waiting for store review, with delta downloads and end-to-end encryption. 1B+ updates per month.
Live updates with channels, gradual rollouts, RSA bundle signing, and automatic rollback.
Capgo Builder builds and signs iOS and Android binaries in the cloud, typically in 2–3 minutes, and can upload them to the stores. Build time is included in plans.
Cloud iOS and Android builds on Platform plans, from 200 to 5,000 build minutes per month, plus store publishing.
Capacitor apps built with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Ionic, or any web framework. Live updates also work for Cordova and Electron. Not for React Native.
Updater plugin and Capgo plugins are free under MPL-2.0. Backend source is on GitHub under AGPL-3.0. Run your own update server, or use licensed self-hosting on Enterprise.
Live Update plugin and CLI are open source under MIT. The cloud service is hosted by Capawesome; bundles can be served from your own servers or CDN while metadata stays in Capawesome Cloud.

blocks.text: Dynamic channels, device and channel overrides, progressive rollouts, automatic rollback when a bundle fails to start, and one-click revert to a previous bundle.
Channels for dev, staging, production, and customer tracks. Rollouts at 10%, 25%, 50%, or 100%, and automatic rollback to the last healthy bundle.
Discord and email with the engineers who build Capgo. Priority plugin fixes on any plan, and Premium Support for production deadlines.
Community chat on every plan. Email support from Professional (Live Updates) or Starter (Platform), and priority support on Business.
Independent and bootstrapped, founded in 2021. 9,400+ teams, 4.7K+ apps, and 90M+ devices. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 on the Enterprise plan.
Capawesome (Genz IT Solutions GmbH), based in Germany. Live updates launched in 2024.

Where Capawesome Cloud is the better choice
No tool fits every team. These are the cases where we would point you to the other option.
Their Live Updates plans start at $9/month for 1,000 monthly active users, below the Capgo entry plan.
Live updates from a git ref
Point their CLI at a branch or tag and the Cloud Runner clones, builds, and ships the live update. With Capgo you build in your own CI and upload the bundle.
Their store publishing covers TestFlight, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery, and Firebase App Distribution.
If you're on Capawesome and considering Capgo, migration is straightforward. The Capacitor update plugin architecture is similar.

blocks.text: The Capgo Capacitor Updater plugin completely transformed how we ship updates. What used to take days now takes just minutes.
Being able to push production OTA updates instantly without waiting for full App Store review cycles has been a massive operational advantage.
Getting set up took less than a day. Channel-based rollouts let me test on my own device before anything hits production users.
Why is Capawesome Ionic's migration partner and not Capgo?

In September 2026 Ionic named Capawesome its preferred migration partner for Appflow and its enterprise plugins. Capgo has never been an Ionic partner. For years we built open alternatives to Ionic's paid products and fixed gaps in the Capacitor ecosystem ourselves, often going further than Ionic's own team, which never made us a fit for their program. Capawesome has always worked the way Ionic prefers. Partner status is a business relationship, not a technical ranking: Capgo and Capawesome have both moved Appflow customers, so compare the products on their merits.
